lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Are you looking for a job?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 是的，我上个星期辞职了。
lines.pinyin: Shì de, wǒ shàng gè xīngqí cízhí le.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 工资太低，又太忙。我想找个更好的。
lines.pinyin: Gōngzī tài dī, yòu tài máng. Wǒ xiǎng zhǎo gè gèng hǎo de.
lines.english: Salary too low, and too busy. I want to find a better one.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What kind of job do you want?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 我想在大公司做经理。或者做老师也可以。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài dà gōngsī zuò jīnglǐ. Huòzhě zuò lǎoshī yě kěyǐ.
lines.english: I want to be a manager at a big company. Or being a teacher is also okay.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 投了几份。下个星期有两个面试。
lines.pinyin: Tóu le jǐ fèn. Xià gè xīngqí yǒu liǎng gè miànshì.
lines.english: Sent a few. Next week have two interviews.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 祝你面试顺利，早日找到好工作！
lines.pinyin: Zhù nǐ miànshì shùnlì, zǎorì zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò!
lines.english: Wishing you successful interviews, find a good job soon!
